theorems.name: Submission.aal_l1th_exists_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ξ : Rn m) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∃ ζ : Rn m → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ζ x ∧ ζ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ (ρ / 2), ζ x = 1) ∧ (∀ x, ρ ≤ dist x ξ → ζ x = 0) ∧ ∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ x‖ ≤ 3 / ρ
